description: This file defines the Sugar_Smarty class, a wrapper around the Smarty templating engine tailored for SugarCRM/SuiteCRM. It manages template directories, plugin registration, and various Smarty customizations specific to the CRM environment.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: A custom wrapper class extending Smarty, providing additional functionality and configuration specific to SugarCRM/SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Sugar_Smarty object, sets up directories, plugins, and configurations.

methods.name: registerPHPFunctions
methods.description: Registers a list of PHP functions as Smarty modifiers.

methods.name: _unlink
methods.description: Overrides Smarty's _unlink method to handle missing files gracefully.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches and renders a template with assigned global variables, honoring developer mode settings.

methods.name: load_filter
methods.description: Loads a specific filter for Smarty.

methods.name: _get_compile_path
methods.description: Generates the path for compiled templates.

methods.name: _get_auto_filename
methods.description: Generates a filename for auto-compiled templates.

methods.name: _get_plugin_filepath
methods.description: Determines the filepath for a Smarty plugin.

methods.name: smarty_core_assemble_plugin_filepath
methods.description: Assembles the plugin filepath, caching results for efficiency.

methods.name: trigger_error
methods.description: Logs errors related to Smarty operations.

methods.name: loadTemplatePath
methods.description: Attempts to load a template from the theme directory, defaulting to custom files if available.
